potion_contents.description: The potion and custom effects contained in this potion, splash potion, lingering potion, or tipped arrow. If defined as a string, corresponds to {{nbt|string|potion}}.

potion.description: The ID of a potion type. Optional. See Potion#Item data.

custom_color.description: The overriding color of this potion texture, and/or the particles of the area effect cloud created.

custom_name.description: An optional string used to generate containing stack name. The game uses the translation key {{cd|item.minecraft.<item type>.effect.<value>}}. This name has a higher priority than the {{cd|minecraft:item_name}} component, but lower than the {{cd|minecraft:custom_name}} component.

custom_effects.description: A list of the additional [ [effect] ]s that this item should apply.

amplifier.description: The amplifier of the effect, with level I having value 0. Optional, defaults to 0.

duration.description: The duration of the effect in ticks. Value -1 is treated as infinity. Values 0 or less than -2 are treated as 1. Optional, defaults to 1 tick.

ambient.description: Whether or not this is an effect provided by a beacon and therefore should be less intrusive on the screen. Optional, defaults to {{cd|false}}.

show_particles.description: Whether or not this effect produces particles. Optional, defaults to {{cd|true}}.

show_icon.description: Whether or not an icon should be shown for this effect. Optional, defaults to {{cd|true}}.
